In [[3630 BBY]],<ref name="Year" /> the [[Dust Vipers]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] gang raided an [[Eternal Alliance]] patrol and stole some sensitive data. Responding to this, the Alliance was led by its [[Alliance Commander|Commander]] to the [[Dust Viper Den]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. The '''battle''' resulted in the defeat and destruction of the pirates, and retrieval of the Alliance data.<ref name="DND" />
